Lily Phillips Parents Tearfully Say They’d Sell Their House for Her to Stop Doing OnlyFans
They initially thought that her subscription page was the “scantily clad” kind, not the “bring 1,000 guys home with you” kind.
Published 51 minutes ago in Wow
People often wonder what the parents of adult content creators think about their work. While some are supportive, others are not, and OF star Lily Phillips’ parents fall distinctly into the latter category.
On a recent episode of Stacey Dooley Sleeps Over, Phillips’ father, Lindsay, said that “if there’s anything we could do to change her profession, we’d do it overnight.”
“Sometimes we think, have we done anything wrong with her upbringing? Well, as far as I’m concerned, we’ve had nothing but nice times and love,” he said. “Is it money? Because if it was money, we’d sell our house. You could have everything you want, Lily, if you gave it all up now.”
This statement and others like it brought Lily to tears. Still, she says she’s not stopping anytime soon, claiming, “I can’t imagine what else I’d be doing. It gives me so much drive and a reason to wake up in the morning.”
“This is something that isn’t degrading for me,” she added. “I still have to live my life how I want to.”
Hey, whatever floats your boat!
